༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rol mtsho bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: rol mtsho bzhugs/ rgyal ba kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang*/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i yum gcig bdag med ma/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug ḍom bhi he ru ka /de yi rjes bzung ngo mtshar rdo rje dang*/ /gsang spyod mthar phyin garba ri pa'i zhabs/ / rigs pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa rgyal ba dpal/ /mkha' 'gro ma mgon rgyal dka' zla ba'i zhabs/ /rtsod dus kun mkhyen ratna a kā ra/ /blo gros mi zad rdo rje gdan pa ste/ /dgyes mdzad brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje dang*/ u rgyan gnas kyi klu'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal rigs skal ldan bi su kalpa'i zhabs/ /rtogs pa don gyi mnga' bdag sa ra ha/ / rab dga' sa grub slob dpon klu grub zhabs/ /'od gsal sgyu ma'i gar mdzad 'phags pa lha/ /bcud len grub pa'i dbang phyug bkra shis ma/ /gdol pa'i rigs las grub brnyes ma tiṅga/ /mkha' 'gros byin rlabs shar phyogs tilli pa/ /bla mas byin rlabs mchog brnyes nā ro pa/ /slob dpon ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta/ /gsang 'dus bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i yum gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dka' ba spyad pas grub brnyes lū hi pa/ /chang tshong mkha' 'gros rjes bzung ṭiṅgi pa/ /bud med gsum bcas grub brnyes dril bu pa/ /sgyu ma'i don gzugs gā ya la pa'i zhabs/ /ye shes mchog gis rnam rol 'bar ba 'dzin/ /rigs pa'i brtul zhugs spyod mdzad nag po pa/ /mngon shes drug ldan dge ba'i mgon po dang*/ /grub chen te lo pa dang nā ro pa/ /mkhas pa blo gros bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ /bde mchog bla ma rnams la= zag med bde ster rnam lnga'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /'byung po 'dul mdzad ku ku ri pa'i zhabs/ /'od gsal rdo rje'i rnam rol padma pa/ /ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhi ba bzang*/ / shanti pa dang rdo rje gdan pa ste/ /sgyu 'phrul bla ma rnams la= /rnal 'byor ma dpal skal pa bzang mo'i zhabs/

/mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzad la lī ta/ / mi bdag inda bhu ti chung ba dang*/ /sgyu 'phrul ma he'i zhal can dpal 'dzin dang*/ /bde chen rang bzhin rnam snang srung ba'i zhabs/ /nus mthus bstan pa skyong mdzad padma srung*/ /'jigs byed bla ma rnams la= /rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje snying po'i zhabs/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ind+ra bhu ti dang*/ /lha lcam dpal mo sa manta badzra/ /dza ya de wa rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /rdo rje 'chang chen blo gros rin chen dang*/ /sha ba ri pa mnga' bdag me tri'i zhabs/ /man ngag rgya mtsho'i mthar son rda chen po/ /rdo rje 'chang chen grub pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ /ratna ka ra a ta ya badzra/ /sgra gcan 'dzin sbas rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ /nye brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ / rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rgya gar ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs te/ brgyud pa'i khyad par gzhan man ngag gtso bor gyur pa la kho bo'i bka' babs brgyud 'debs su sbyar zin/ 'di ni gzhung gi brgyud pa gtso che ba yin te tā ra nā thas so/ /de yang*/ mthar thug ston pa rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ /dbyer med mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor zhabs/ /rin chen brtson 'grus dpon ston skyer rgang pa/ /gnyen ston chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa mchog /rin chen brgyud pa lnga la= /mkhas grub khyung po rne ston yon tshul dang*/ /rdo rje tshul khrims steng ba tshul khrims bstan/ /bla ma bsod mdzes yon tan rgyal ba'i mtshan/ /'dren mchog rin chen bstan pa rgyas pa sogs/ /bka' babs rim brgyud rnams la=/ / mkhas btsun sangs rgyas 'jig chen byams pa dpal/ /chos dpal bzang po 'khrul zhig tshul rgyan dang*/ /mkhyen par mchog grub kun bzang chos nyid sogs/ /bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rnams la= /gtsang ma shing ston khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ /ri khrod ras chen shing dkar rin rgyal ba/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*/

/rgya sgom legs rgyal sems kyi mdud grol mchog /lha dbang grags pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang*/ khyad 'phags rtsa ba'i brgyud par= /brgyud srol kun 'dus gsang bdag sgrol ba'i mgon/ /rin chen rgya mtsho blo gros rnam par rgyal/ /ngag dbang 'phrin las ngag dbang rnam par rgyal/ /mnyam med dam pa rnams la= /dgyes rdor gsang 'dus bde mchog sgyu ma che/ /'jigs mdzad ye shes rnam lnga'i dkyil 'khor pa/ /mkha' 'gro sde lnga myur mdzad mgon po sogs/ /zung 'jug snying po'i lha la= /smin byed dbang bzhi'i rigs kyi gsos theb nas/ /dam tshig rnam dag mthu chen gegs med tshogs/ /bskyed rim brtan thob rdzogs rim mtha' ru phyin/ /mi slob zung 'jug tshe 'dir mngon byed shog /de ma thob pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du/ /bla ma lhag pa'i lha dang mi 'bral zhing*/ /dka' ba med par rdo rje sa lam bsgrod/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis bde rlag 'grub gyur cig /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro yi/ /byin rlabs bdag gi rgyud la rab zhugs te/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /'phrin las 'khor lo myur du 'god nus shog/ // ces shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong 'di blo gros mtha' yas kyis bgyis pa dge legs su gyur cig/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rgyud sde lnga'i brgyud 'debs dngos grub rol mtsho bzhugs/ - PAGE 66 -- PAGE 65 -- PAGE 63 -
